content.rendered:
Every celebration deserves something personal. Something that feels like it was made just for that moment.

That’s exactly where Christina Dittman Creations began.

What started as a love for art, lettering, and meaningful details grew into a passion for creating custom hand-painted banners that turn ordinary events into unforgettable experiences. Whether it’s a wedding, birthday, baby shower, engagement, graduation, or a once-in-a-lifetime celebration, each banner is designed to reflect your story.

No templates. No shortcuts. Just thoughtful, handcrafted work.

The Heart Behind the Craft

At the core of Christina Dittman Creations is a simple idea: the small details matter.

A banner isn’t just decoration. It’s the backdrop to your photos. The focal point of your event. The piece people remember long after the celebration ends.

That’s why every banner is:

  • Hand-painted with care
  • Designed specifically for your occasion
  • Created with attention to color, style, and theme
  • Made to feel personal, not mass-produced

Each order is treated like it’s for a close friend or family member—because that level of care shows in the final result.

Custom Made, Start to Finish

Every banner begins with your vision.

From the wording and colors to the overall style, each detail is carefully planned and brought to life by hand. Whether you want something elegant and minimal or bold and eye-catching, the goal is always the same: to create a piece that feels uniquely yours.

You’re not just ordering a banner—you’re collaborating on something meaningful.

Designed for Life’s Biggest Moments

Christina Dittman Creations proudly creates banners for:

  • Weddings
  • Birthdays
  • Baby Showers
  • Engagement Celebrations
  • Graduations
  • And all of life’s special occasions

If it matters to you, it matters here.

Made With Care, Meant to Last

There’s something special about handmade work. You can see it. You can feel it.

Every brushstroke, every letter, every detail is created with intention. The result is more than just décor—it’s a keepsake you’ll want to hold onto long after the event is over.

Effective Date: March 2026

Christina Dittman Creations (“we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or submit a request for custom hand-painted banners.

Information We Collect

When you interact with our website, we may collect the following information:

Personal Information You Provide

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number
  • Event details (such as type of event, date, and design preferences)
  • Any additional information you submit through our contact or order forms

Automatically Collected Information

  • IP address
  • Browser type and device information
  • Pages visited and time spent on the site

This information helps us improve your experience and better understand how our website is used.

How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Respond to inquiries and provide quotes
  • Communicate with you about your custom banner order
  • Process and manage orders
  • Improve our website and services
  • Send updates related to your request or order

We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties.

How We Protect Your Information

We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure. While no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, we strive to use commercially acceptable means to safeguard your data.

Sharing Your Information

We may share your information only in the following situations:

  • With trusted service providers who help us operate our website or fulfill orders
  • When required by law or to comply with legal obligations

We only share the minimum necessary information and ensure appropriate safeguards are in place.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your browsing experience. Cookies help us understand how visitors use our site and allow us to improve functionality.

You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings.

Your Choices and Rights

You have the right to:

  • Request access to the personal information we hold about you
  • Request corrections or updates to your information
  • Request deletion of your personal data

To make any of these requests, please contact us using the information below.

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those websites.

Children’s Privacy

Our services are not directed toward individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact us:

Christina Dittman Creations
[Insert Email Address]
[Insert Phone Number]
